iti37:2.1: Dvīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭhe-va dhamme sukha somanassa bahulo viharati, yoniso āraddho hoti āsavānaṃ khayāya.
iti37:2.3: Saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvejanena saṃvegassa ca yoniso padhānena.
iti37:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave dvīhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu diṭṭhe-va dhamme sukhasomanassabahulo viharati, yoniso āraddho hoti āsavānaṃ khayāyā-ti.
iti37:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||10||
iti37:6.4: somanassena (37) te dasā-ti || 38. (Duk. II.1) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ
